summary: Live-update runtime, configuration, delivery, and binary-adoption migration from Capawesome Cloud to Capgo.

capabilities.notes: Replace the updater package and synchronize native projects; a new Capgo-enabled binary is mandatory.
Translate fetch, download, next-bundle, reload, and diagnostics only when the app intentionally uses them.
Approve explicit channel, rollout, and native-version boundaries before enabling target delivery.
Keep the CI provider and replace only the bundle-delivery step with approved runtime credentials.
Archive source records separately; this skill does not promise historical data import.
Use normal human-owned signing and store-release processes; do not extract or copy credentials.
